## What's new

- **See what's new after an update.** After an update, a window shows what changed in every version since the one you had, so nothing is missed if you skip a release. The version number is now shown in the footer, and clicking it, or **Help › What's New...**, shows the latest changes at any time.
- **Progress for covers, below the menu.** When covers are chosen for several folders, a panel below the menu shows which folder it's on, how many are done, about how long is left and the last cover given, with a **Stop** button. When it finishes it says what happened, and **Show them** lists any folders that had no screenshot that would do. It used to be a line in the footer, which could run into the other text on smaller screens.
- **An activity log.** **Help › Activity Log...** shows what the app has done on this PC over the last 30 days: rebuilds, refreshes, imports, covers, trims, updates, every file deleted, and anything that went wrong, such as a video ffmpeg couldn't read. If the app or the PC stops without closing properly, the next start notes what the app was last doing and what Windows recorded about the restart. You can search it, show only the problems, copy lines, and clear a day or all of it.
- **Choose how much is logged.** **Settings › Tools › Activity log** offers **Detailed** (every scene of a rebuild), **Normal** (the default), **Problems only** or **Off**.

## Changes

- **Rebuild All Screenshots:** drag the gap between Drives and Problems to give the problems more room. The size is kept for next time.

## Fixes

- Clicking the tick box on a folder tile opened the folder, or undid itself when other folders were already picked. It now just picks or unpicks the folder.
